g.text: Posterior CDF diagnostics separate calibration from task behavior

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: CDF at simulator truth · one value per independent case · all cases retained, including failed reference outcomes

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Top gray band: 95% DKW simultaneous bound for one independent-case ECDF under uniform calibration; not a familywise test across panels or methods.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Bottom: descriptive task diagnostics; ecological feature generation is outside the conditional likelihood, so uniformity is not the asserted null.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: A frozen prior can pass marginal prior-predictive checks without learning. The data-dependent likelihood statistic provides a complementary check.
